C0489.title: The 'Kuai a Da Ti' AI CAPTCHA-solving Platform Case
C0489.summary: In 2017, during the '1·03' cybercrime operation in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, suspects Li Qi, Yang Kequn, and others built the 'Kuai a Da Ti' platform, which provided automated image CAPTCHA recognition services for credential-stuffing attackers, achieving a recognition accuracy rate of over 95% and bypassing internet companies' CAPTCHA security systems.
